metadata.title: Want to invest in YC startups? Robinhood has a new fund for that

content.text: Robinhood CFO and Robinhood Ventures President Shiv Verma joins CoinDesk's Jennifer Sanasie from the floor of the New York Stock Exchange on the day Robinhood Ventures Fund II began trading. Verma breaks down how the fund gives everyday investors access to early-stage Y Combinator companies at the ground floor.
